question: 4xV100-SXM2-16GB集群在NVLink互联下，TP=4场景下的All-Reduce通信延迟约为0.5-1.0ms/step，占单token生成总时间的15-25%；当batch_size>4时，PCIe带宽瓶颈导致吞吐线性扩展效率低于60%，理论最大可持续吞吐约为20-30 tokens/s (per sequence)。

sources.title: [Engine] Native NVLink peer-to-peer support for 4x Tesla V100 ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: Context / Background I am running a multi-GPU setup featuring 4x NVIDIA Tesla V100 16GB (Volta, sm_70) cards. The hardware infrastructure uses a custom 4-GPU topology expansion/bridge board based on the PLX PEX 8748 PCIe Gen3 switch. The entire cluster connects to the host machine via a single Oculink x4 link (currently upgrading to SlimSAS 8i x8).
